split_policy: preserve official train/val/test membership; no test use during development

preprocessing.frame_sampling: uniform frame indices using rint(linspace(0, N-1, T)); repeats for short clips

model.name: compact_3d_cnn_from_scratch
model.head: global average pooling and one logit
model.blocks: Conv3d(kernel=3,stride=2,padding=1,bias=True), ReLU; repeated for each channel count
model.pool: global mean over temporal and spatial dimensions

training.pilot_selection: deterministic proportional class sample within official training only; record manifest before fitting

evaluation.checkpoint_selection: highest validation average precision; earliest epoch on ties
evaluation.final_test: reserved; no test loading, inference, tuning or checkpoint selection

limitations: clip-level splits allow same-patient overlap; no unseen-patient generalization claim
eight inspection clips are not a training dataset or a metric estimate
pilot is not a reproduction of the paper or a final experiment

diagnostics.selection: first two per class in the ranked pilot manifest; training only

comparison.changed_variable: positive-class weight in training loss only
comparison.weight_rule: number of non-RD training clips / number of RD training clips
comparison.initialization: fresh model and Adam state with the same seed; no checkpoint fine-tuning
comparison.baseline_selection: baseline_001 checkpoint selected by validation average precision
comparison.threshold_tuning: none; fixed at 0.5 for this comparison
